summary: Krea-2 + the chinese-ink-linen-scroll LoRA. Muted colour on a woven linen ground — the substrate texture is what makes it read as a real scroll rather than a digital painting. Ryan 2026-08-12: 'stunning.'
graphStatus: NOT WRITTEN YET — shares the Krea-2 graph with krea2-darkbrush; only the LoRA and trigger change.

baseNote: Tagged base_model:krea/Krea-2-Turbo, so TURBO is the default here — unlike darkbrush, this one's card and tags agree. Try raw as the A/B, not as the default.
unknowns: Every published sample is a SCENE. No close portrait exists, and close portraiture is where scroll styles usually break — which is exactly what the narration use case needs.
The linen weave is high-frequency texture. Beautiful in a still; the most likely thing to crawl frame-to-frame in video.
Two of three samples carry red seal stamps. Native and correct in this idiom — but Ryan has spent months treating seals as an artefact to suppress.
